headline: One argument, told in the order it happened.

steps.label: Consumer Tech
steps.note: Learning what hundreds of millions of people actually do, not what they say.

steps.label: Growth
steps.note: Distribution as a product discipline. Engines, not campaigns.

steps.label: Health Tech
steps.note: Changing behaviour is harder than changing software. Retention is the product.

steps.label: Entrepreneurship
steps.note: Building the company, not just the product. Teams, cadence, capital.

steps.label: AI
steps.note: The first technology where the interface is judgement, not a screen.

steps.label: European Sovereignty
steps.note: Who builds the system decides whose rules it follows.

steps.label: Defence
steps.note: Decision advantage as the deliverable. Speed under constraint.

steps.label: Public Safety
steps.note: Where trust is not a feature. It is the licence to operate.

conclusion: Nothing here was a pivot. Each step made the next one obvious.

timeline.headline: Fourteen years, one direction.
